page.overview:
Who is Trinita Orikasa?

Trinita is described as a female white cat with a pretty face and short fur.

The cat had a black cloth collar with a silver heart-shaped nameplate hanging from it, along with a phone number and the owner's name written.

Trinita had spent her days with Hanae and held affection towards her.

Trinita was a cat who, alongside her mother, belonged to Hanae Orikasa.
